description: Change detection for polling agents: pass the hash you saw last time and get changed:true/false back instead of re-reading and diffing the whole payload yoursel

check.description: What to watch: token (safety verdict), price (USD price), dns (DNS records plus HTTP status) or gas (gas price). Default token.

since.description: The hash returned by your previous call. Omit on the first call.

target.description: Contract address (check=token|price), domain (check=dns) or chain (check=gas, default base)

name: changed
